title: System Settings
subtitle: Manage Feishu bot connection and system configuration.
feishuBotDescription: Connect your Feishu bot to manage inventory via Feishu messages.
feishuNotConfiguredHint: Configure the Feishu App ID and App Secret in config file or environment variables.
feishuConfigHint: Modify the values below and click Save to apply. Leave App Secret empty to keep the current value.
feishuEnableHint: When enabled, the bot can receive and respond to messages.
feishuAppSecretHint: The current App Secret is not displayed. Enter a new value to replace it, or leave empty to keep the existing one.
